verdict.rationale: Fastmail is a SaaS email service with a public JMAP API and API tokens, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test tenant or non-production API environment. Using a separate account via multiple-account login would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
